brief: The paper-fan spirit lifting a folded hand to show three folds, each with a word, one for a figure who has gone, one for a said word, one for a finished thing; the Vetāla and Dādī watching; firelight.

A slim spirit like a folded paper fan unfolding in the firelight, each fold holding a line of tiny writing; the Vetāla speaking quickly with a hand pointing at the sky; Śuka looking lost; Dādī smiling and explaining.
The paper-fan spirit folding his answer into a single word on one fold; Śuka testing words with a raised wing; Dādī smiling; the Vetāla listening with half-closed eyes; firelight.

A small quick spirit sitting on a tree stump with strings of tiny glass beads around its neck and wrists, sliding a bead onto a larger bead marked with a root; Śuka cocking his head; Dādī and the Vetāla watching; firelight on the glass.
